test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. Pushpa is (A)/knows all (B)/the facts about (C)/the indicent (D).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in part (A) of the sentence, "**Pushpa is**."
 
• The auxiliary verb "**is**" cannot be used directly before a main verb in the simple present tense (e.g., "knows").
 
• The sentence should use the simple present tense to state a fact, where the singular subject "Pushpa" is followed directly by the verb "**knows**."
 
• Removing "**is**" restores the grammatical structure of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Pushpa **knows all the facts** about the incident."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **B: "knows all" **– This is the correct third-person singular verb form required for the subject "Pushpa."
 
• **C: "the facts about"** – This segment is used correctly to indicate the subject matter.
 
• **D: "the indicent"** – Although "indicent" is a spelling error (should be "incident"), the syntactic error in part A is the primary grammatical flaw in the sentence structure.
